name: Imouto no Seiiki
source:
This is the second title in feng’s low-price Seiiki series, focusing on younger sister Yukana Nase.

When Youhei was small, he used to visit Akiba often. Even though it was for his younger sister Yukana, he soon got hooked on game centres and that’s how he became friends with his ojou-sama classmate Fuyuka. One day, Fuyuka gifted Yukana with a Christmas trip and the siblings enjoyed their time alone together like a couple. Looking at his younger sister, he realized that still hasn’t saved her from that time.

“You won’t let your younger sister take your virginity even though you’re into Akiba stuff… I hate you, onii-chan!”

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/07/12/july-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是枫的低价精气系列的第二部作品，主要讲述妹妹名濑由佳奈的故事。

阳平小的时候，经常去秋叶原。虽然是为了妹妹由加奈，但他很快就迷上了游戏机，并因此与大城大人的同学冬花成为了朋友。有一天，冬香送给由佳奈一次圣诞旅行的礼物，兄妹俩像情侣一样享受着独处的时光。看着自己的妹妹，他发现这一切仍然没有能拯救她。

“虽然你很喜欢秋叶原，但你也不会让你的妹妹夺去你的贞操……我讨厌你，哥哥！”

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/07/12/july-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
